    for r in csv.DictReader(f):
        if r['timeseries_id']!=tsid: continue
        t=r['timestamp']
        if not t.startswith('2018-01'): continue
        d=t[:10]; h=int(t[11:13])
        day[d][h]=float(r['value'])
def complete(dd): return all(h in dd for h in range(24))
daily={d:sum(dd.values()) for d,dd in day.items() if complete(dd)}

mean=sum(daily.values())/len(daily)
count=sum(1 for v in daily.values() if v > 1.10*mean)
